resources.string: When off, use an installed local system voice.
Choose a model supporting the Speech API
Only OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech with MP3 is supported. Listing a model does not guarantee compatibility. Verify support and enter the provider-specific voice ID.
Preparing audio; tap again to cancel

Audio is machine-generated, not a human recording. System mode selects voices declared local by the engine and asks you to install a voice if missing. Cloud mode sends cleaned reply text and may incur charges. Failures never switch services or restart automatically. Stopping speech does not stop the Agent task.
Hello, I am Daiyu. This is a speech preview.
